hook: Pods from Metro stations straight to buildings around *Hussainsagar* are being studied
hook_b: Pods from Metro stations straight to buildings around *Hussainsagar* are being studied
tldr: HUMTA outlined pod transport near Hussainsagar, transit-oriented plans for SR Nagar and LB Nagar, and common bus-Metro ticketing at Cyberabad Moves.

beats.what: HUMTA MD B. Jeevan Babu said techno-economic feasibility studies are under way for a pod system linking Metro stations to buildings around Hussainsagar.
beats.why: He said the city's transport is not well integrated, with bus stops often far from Metro and MMTS stations.
beats.care: SR Nagar and LB Nagar local area plans envisage shops below, homes above and multi-level parking to switch to bus or Metro.

causes.label: Bus stops far from Metro, MMTS stations

effects.label: Shops below, homes above in SR Nagar, LB Nagar

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: HUMTA also wants to link the 23-km cycle track to Kokapet and the Financial District, and use space under flyovers for sports.
